title: The Elect Solution
description: A fully responsive e-commerce web application built with React and Tailwind CSS. It features a structured product listing system, reusable UI components, and a map interface that enhances user experience through location-based interaction and improved navigation flow.

title: Job Listing Website
description: A modern job listing platform built with React and Tailwind CSS. It delivers a clean, responsive interface for exploring job opportunities with dynamic rendering of listings and an optimized user experience across all screen sizes.

title: E-commerce Website
description: A responsive e-commerce web application built with HTML, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. It includes product listing functionality, interactive cart behavior, authentication UI flow, and a well-structured layout focused on usability and smooth user interaction.

title: Akademi Dashboard
description: A responsive school management dashboard built with React and Tailwind CSS. It includes student, teacher, finance, food, chat, calendar, user, and activity management, using reusable components and React Router for a seamless user experience across all devices.
